prompt: A text field named "input" reports every edit through a DocumentListener. Complete the three listener methods so a JLabel named "echo" always shows the field's current text in upper case.
explanation: Unlike an ActionListener, which only fires when Enter is pressed, a DocumentListener hears every single change to a text component's model -- including programmatic setText calls, which fire a remove event followed by an insert event. Because all three callbacks should react identically, the idiomatic solution delegates to one private helper that reads input.getText() and updates the label. Reading state is fine inside a DocumentListener; you just must not mutate the document itself from the callback.
hints: Write one private helper method that sets the echo label, and call it from all three listener methods.
input.getText() always returns the field's current full text -- you do not need the DocumentEvent details.
String.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) converts the text; pass the result to echo.setText.
